board.task: Find planted bugs: {plantedTotal} across two repositories, count fixed
board.timeDefinition: wall clock summed over both repositories; the board says its machines were shared with other work for some rows, so times compare loosely at best
board.costDefinition: list-rate API price estimated from usage counts, summed over both repositories; not an invoice or subscription billing

own.task: Find known defects in code changes under review
own.timeDefinition: wall-clock minutes per review as recorded by the evaluator; reviews may have shared the machine with other work
own.limitations: Measured by the repository owner on a private set of code-review cases that this repository does not publish, so it cannot be reproduced here; some of the cases also chose between seats, so treat the figure as the owner's result on the owner's cases, not a ranking; it does not compare with the board entries, which use a different task
own.rationaleTail: A result on the owner's cases that a user can weigh beside the board entries, not a measured guarantee

entries.limitations: Counts planted bugs, not review quality on real changes; repeated attempts are not independent replications; runs used a 1M context window, and the board says its older Opus 5 rows are not comparable to these; the board also lists low and max rungs that this entry leaves out
entries.rationaleTail: A lower effort supports a balanced starting point, not equivalence

entries.timeDefinition: wall clock summed over both repositories; the board says the machine was idle for these runs, so the times do not compare with the Opus entry's
entries.costDefinition: list-rate API price estimated from usage counts, summed over both repositories; the board notes its harness priced this model on another model's table, so the dollar figure is less certain than the usage counts
entries.limitations: Same board limits as the Opus entry; its older Sonnet 5 rows are not comparable to these; the board also lists low, medium and max rungs that this entry leaves out
entries.rationaleTail: Suggest it only where the user allows that model and effort

entries.route: Meta API through a Muse Code subscription plan; no per-use price
entries.timeDefinition: active wall clock summed over both repositories; the board says its machine was shared with other work, and some runs were resumed in segments, so only active time is counted
entries.costDefinition: unknown: Meta publishes no price for this model, so no dollar figure is recorded
entries.limitations: Few runs per effort, and the board measures a median run-to-run move of about a point and a half on three-run configurations, so a gap of that size between efforts is not a difference; the board lists no high or lower rung; reachable only through a Muse Code subscription plan, so it fits a user who already has one; its usage draws on that plan's rolling windows, which the board does not measure
entries.rationaleTail: Suggest it as an additional seat from a different model family where the user has a Muse Code plan and allows the effort; start at xhigh, and use max only on request

entries.route: OpenAI Codex CLI on a ChatGPT account; no per-use price
entries.timeDefinition: wall clock summed over both repositories on cloud machines, not the laptop most other rows ran on, so it does not compare with them
entries.limitations: Counts planted bugs, not review quality on real changes; the board ran every GPT-6.2 row with file timestamps flattened and a newer Codex than earlier OpenAI rows, so a gap against them is model plus client plus machine; the board also lists low and max rungs that this entry leaves out; list cost is an estimate, not what a ChatGPT plan charges
entries.rationaleTail: A lower effort supports a balanced starting point, not equivalence; suggest it where the user has a Codex plan and allows the model and effort

entries.route: Google AI Ultra subscription through the Antigravity CLI
entries.timeDefinition: wall clock summed over both repositories on a laptop, excluding the waits for the subscription's usage windows to reopen
entries.limitations: Counts planted bugs, not review quality on real changes; runs were resumed after the subscription's five-hour usage window ran out, so a user on a smaller plan may hit that limit sooner; the board also lists low and medium rungs that this entry leaves out; list cost is an estimate from the CLI's own usage counts, sub-agents included
entries.rationaleTail: Suggest it as an additional seat from a different model family where the user has a Google AI Ultra plan and allows the effort
